name: Fund
definition: A legal entity is a Fund while it is managed by another legal entity as a pool of investor capital. It says the body is run by a manager for its investors, which is not the same as being a PortCo, a body in which others hold a stake.
distinct_need: Names the pooled-capital vehicle that a manager runs; no other role says a body is managed for investors.

name: GP
definition: A legal entity is a GP while it manages a fund. It says the body runs the fund and answers for it, which is not the same as being an Investor, a body that holds a stake in something.
distinct_need: Names the party that runs a fund; no other role says a body manages a pool of capital.

name: LP
definition: A legal entity is an LP while it commits capital to a fund. It says the body has promised money to a fund and shares in its returns, which is not the same as being an Investor in a company, a body that holds a stake in a company.
distinct_need: Names the party that supplies a fund's capital; no other role says a body has promised capital to a fund.

name: Investor
definition: A legal entity is an Investor while it invests in another legal entity. It says the body owns part of something below it in the structure, which is not the same as being an LP, which has only promised capital to a fund.
distinct_need: Names the holder of a stake in a company or vehicle; no other role says a body owns part of another.

name: PortCo
definition: A legal entity is a PortCo while another legal entity invests in it. It covers an operating company and also a holding vehicle set up to hold one, and says something is held in it, which is not the same as being a Fund, a body that is managed for investors.
distinct_need: Names the legal entity in which a stake is held; no other role says a body has an owner below a fund.

name: Parallel Vehicle
definition: A legal entity is a Parallel Vehicle while it invests alongside another fund. It says the body takes part in the same investments as a fund, which is not the same as being that fund's investor.
distinct_need: Names a vehicle that shares a fund's investments without holding an interest in the fund.

name: Transfer
definition: A transaction is a Transfer while it is paid by one party and received by another. It says the event itself, which is not the same as the party that paid or received.
distinct_need: Names the event in which money or a holding moves; no other role says a transaction has parties.

name: Payer
definition: A legal entity is a Payer while it pays into a transaction. It says the body gave money, and received the holding if there was one, which is not the same as being the Payee.
distinct_need: Names the party that pays in a transaction; no other role says which side of a transaction paid.

name: Payee
definition: A legal entity is a Payee while it receives from a transaction. It says the body took money and gave up the holding if there was one, which is not the same as being the Payer.
distinct_need: Names the party that receives in a transaction; no other role says which side of a transaction was paid.

name: Traded Instrument
definition: An instrument is a Traded Instrument while a transaction transfers it. It says the instrument was the subject of an event, which is not the same as the instrument's issuer.
distinct_need: Names the instrument that a transaction concerns; no other role links an instrument to an event.
